commits.message:
feat(taxonomy): editable job titles, with duplicate-rename protection and bulk reclassification

Job titles were the only canonical taxonomy without an edit path --
Skills already had inline description editing; Job titles was
search/filter/sort-only, view-only. Also found while checking: 219 of
262 canonical job titles (83%) are still family="Unclassified", the
default add_canonical_job_title stamps on approval -- a real backlog
with no fast way to clear it.

update_canonical_job_title (app/understanding/taxonomy/loader.py) lets
a reviewer rename a title or reclassify its family/seniority, live
immediately, same pattern as every other taxonomy write this session.
A rename that would collide (by normalized key) with a DIFFERENT
existing title is refused, not silently merged into it -- the same
"never allow a duplicate" guard add_canonical_job_title already applies
to brand-new entries, now applied to edits too. The old title text is
kept as an alias on rename rather than dropped, so a posting that still
uses the old wording (real postings lag behind a taxonomy fix) stays
recognized instead of starting to look like a new unknown term again.

bulk_set_job_title_family reclassifies several selected titles' family
in one write -- the fast path for clearing the Unclassified backlog
without editing 219 entries one at a time. New PATCH /taxonomy/job-titles
and POST /taxonomy/job-titles/bulk-set-family endpoints (app/routers/
moderation.py).

JobTitlesTaxonomyPage.tsx: per-row inline edit (title/family/seniority,
family field autocompletes against the taxonomy's existing families via
a datalist rather than a hardcoded enum) plus row selection with a bulk
"set family for selected" action, mirroring the Taxonomy candidates
page's selection UX. Everything here is a human decision applied
deterministically -- no auto-classification, no LLM guessing a family.

New coverage: renaming keeps the old wording recognized as an alias
resolving to the new canonical title; a rename that collides with a
different existing title is refused and leaves the original untouched;
reclassifying family/seniority works without a rename; editing a
nonexistent title fails cleanly; bulk-setting family updates several
titles in one call. Full regression suite (18 checks, 5 new) green
against a fresh schema and rebuilt image; frontend type-checks and
builds clean.
